node.statement: If dim_C A=1, the extended 2t-inclusion from the preceding node has at level one ||I_A||=||v(1)||>=(1-2t)||1||>=1/2 because t<=e_0=1/4. Hence I_A is nonzero. The linear map v:C->A is injective since v(lambda)=0 implies |lambda| ||I_A||=0, and it is surjective because its image contains the nonzero vector I_A in the one-dimensional complex space A. Thus v is bijective.
